verdict.rationale: First-party Copilot docs state that Copilot Chat is available in Teams and can work over the user's work data (Microsoft Graph and Work IQ), so in-product AI over the user's data is documented. The evidence is a few brief mentions, mostly from the separate Microsoft 365 Copilot overview, and does not describe specific insights or suggestions over Teams chats, meetings or files. Missing for 10: concrete documentation of AI-generated insights/suggestions derived from Teams data (e.g., summaries or recommendations), clarity on whether this ships natively in Teams versus as a separate Copilot offering, independent or hands-on corroboration.
